issue.title: test_single_section_cycles_to_top_in_both_directions fails under just check-full's full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Discovered by epic sase-wm's verify phase (bead sase-wm.5, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2, 2026-09-05) while verifying the Projects-tab init flow: the epic's just check-full run completed but failed this prompt-panel section-navigation node, and the same node passed immediately when rerun alone on the unchanged tree (master fab5ccc37). The failure is unrelated to the init-flow changes under test. Per retired umbrella sase-ct's close policy, this is a narrow node-specific record; re-measure with just test-contention and check tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt before treating it as reproducible.
